source_snapshot.procedure: Generic setup says clear logs; open Dashboard and Server Health > Sensor Reading.
source_snapshot.criteria: Sensor reading and threshold are human readable and match specification.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES may read the label but truncates fallback inventory and cannot prove the exact FPGA/bitstream, BMC source, on-die versus board-local field or complete UI/spec agreement.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION requires FPGA identity/location, passive read-only collection and complete UI/spec evidence.

old_problem: A named temperature could be accepted without proving the exact FPGA instance, role, board reference and active image or whether the value is an on-die/package sensor or nearby board channel. Another FPGA/CPLD, board aggregate, version evidence or host utility value could falsely substitute, and reset/programming could be added without authority.
disposition_reason: Bind the stable record and both UI rows to the exact FPGA silicon, part/revision/reference designator/role and active image, then to the BMC controller/bus/mux/address die/package/board field. Compare complete evidence with measurement-specific thermal limits under the existing passive power/load/cooling state. Identity and limits are Project parameters; no FPGA state change is required.
decision_basis: XLSX row 892, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, internal Script reference, selection manifest, related source cases and historical record were directly reviewed.
FPGA labeling does not distinguish among programmable devices or prove whether the reading is silicon junction, package or adjacent board temperature.
Active bitstream identity helps bind the target but is not itself temperature evidence; host/vendor telemetry is equivalent only when the same FPGA and field are proven.
ED-15 requires field-specific limits, ED-17 preserves FPGA/thermal logs and ED-14 keeps dynamic threshold and functional behavior separate.

test_case.test_name: Verify TEMP_GB_FPGA against the exact FPGA, active image and BMC measurement field
test_case.purpose: Verify TEMP_GB_FPGA maps to the intended GPU-baseboard FPGA and exact die/package/board field and is human readable in Dashboard and Server Health with correct value, units, health, implemented thresholds/hysteresis and freshness under the recorded passive FPGA/system load and cooling state.
required_package: Chassis/GPU-baseboard PN/revision, BMC/BIOS and FPGA role
FPGA vendor/device/part/revision/serial/reference designator, active bitstream/image version and configuration state
Exact die/package or board-local sensor part and BMC controller/bus/mux/address/field
Stable SDR/API and Dashboard/Server Health identities
Field-specific units/scaling, approved range/delta, threshold capability/values/hysteresis, health, polling/freshness and unavailable rules
Recorded host/GPU/FPGA power and functional-load state, fan speeds, inlet and baseboard airflow
Validated protected OOB/API/browser clients and pinned immutable reviewed `sensor.git` revision/checksum or approved manual read-only method
test_case.test_command: Do not clear SEL/kernel/FPGA/thermal logs, start FPGA workload, reset/reconfigure/reprogram the FPGA, reload a bitstream, service hardware, alter fans/airflow/thresholds or flash firmware. Confirm the exact FPGA instance/role/reference and active image and bind the BMC measurement field. Resolve one stable TEMP_GB_FPGA identity from the complete repository; review the Script before use. Capture complete identity, value, units, capability/threshold/hysteresis, health and timestamp plus unchanged Dashboard and Server Health rows. Record passive FPGA/system load and cooling state and compare only with the approved field-specific specification. Stop without retry on identity, source, stale or UI/OOB/device divergence.
test_case.expected_result: One stable record and both UI rows map to the documented FPGA instance, active image context and exact BMC die/package/board field. Complete OOB/UI value, units, thresholds, health and freshness match field-specific limits under the recorded passive state. Another FPGA/CPLD, board aggregate, image/version or unmatched host field never substitutes and FPGA state remains unchanged.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact FPGA/image/source identity, complete OOB and both-UI agreement, field-specific specification and engineer verdict. Label existence, image version, another programmable device, board aggregate, plausible value, truncated output or command success alone cannot pass. Wrong/stale identity, out-of-limit value or required threshold/status/UI mismatch is FAIL. Missing FPGA/source/spec/reviewed method is NOT READY, not Pending or PASS; logic function, workload response, reset/programming and dynamic threshold behavior are outside scope.
safety_gate: Do not clear SEL, kernel, FPGA or thermal logs; device-health context must be preserved.
Do not accept the label alone; prove exact FPGA silicon/reference/role/image and die/package/board measurement point.
Do not replace the BMC field with FPGA function/version evidence or vendor telemetry without exact field equivalence.
Do not load/reset/reconfigure/reprogram/service the FPGA, reload bitstream, alter cooling/thresholds or flash firmware.
Preserve the existing power/load/cooling state; static display does not authorize dynamic testing.
Do not truncate output, expose credentials or run an unreviewed Script; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Chassis/GPU-baseboard PN/revision, BMC/BIOS and exact FPGA vendor/device/part/revision/serial/reference/role/active-image identity
BMC controller/bus/mux/address and exact die/package/board temperature field with stable SDR/UI identity
Complete stable raw value, units, threshold capabilities/values, health and timestamp plus separate Dashboard and Server Health rows
FPGA/field-specific specification and recorded host/GPU/FPGA power/load, fan/inlet/airflow state with any approved equivalent telemetry
Stale/divergent disposition and pinned Script or alternate-method audit
No-clear/no-load/no-reset-or-programming/no-retry proof, final FPGA/BMC health and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: No mutation is expected. On FPGA, active-image or measurement-field ambiguity, stale/divergent data or unexpected FPGA/BMC health change, stop and preserve the first complete evidence plus configuration state. Use approved read-only BMC/FPGA inventory diagnostics; do not reset, reload or reprogram the device to force evidence. Any independently authorized FPGA action requires its own recovery image and owner execution.

source_conflict.reason: The exact FPGA and field are Project-defined, but Items, UI Procedure and Criteria consistently request passive display/spec validation of one FPGA-associated temperature.

blocked.reason: The passive FPGA-temperature purpose is clear. Exact device/image/source field and acceptance are supplyable Project inputs.
